title: feat(ui): click workspace-pill path to reveal in Finder
context:
The cwd path shown in the input-context strip (e.g. "~/Apps/content-engine")
was inert text. Wired it to the existing /api/open endpoint the same way
other path chips in CCC already do — clicking it now runs `open -R` to
reveal the folder in Finder (no launch flag, so it never executes anything).

Fixes CCC-921.
